pinned.title: NFSU Gandhinagar — MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application closes
pinned.body: Selection is on your CUET-PG 2026 score, not a separate NFSU test. 24 seats. Apply off the Samarth portal. Eligibility: 4-yr BA/BSc Psych, or 3-yr + bridge, min 55%.

pinned.body: Same program, Delhi campus, same CUET-PG-based selection, 22 seats. Apply to both NFSU campuses off the one Samarth portal, two more shots for the same effort.

feed.title: RML / ABVIMS — MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application closes
feed.body: Closes first of everything live. Runs on the GGSIPU portal, admission is the CET-166 entrance (not your MET). 70% test + 30% interview, app fee Rs 2,500. Deadline was extended from 30 May to 7 June, so it is genuinely open. Do this one today.

feed.title: MET 2026 (Manipal) — result watch
feed.body: MET Phase 1 scorecard came out 17 April, Phase 2 around late May. For MA Clinical Psychology the live thread now is the program merit list + counselling call, not a new application. Log in at manipal.edu with the email and password you used to register and check your scorecard / merit status.

feed.title: NIMHANS 2026 — result watch
feed.body: NIMHANS held its PG entrance 29–31 May 2026 (MA Clinical Psych on 31 May, PhD 30 May). Results post to the official results page below. No date announced yet; check it directly rather than trusting any aggregator.

feed.title: RCI Admissions Tracker rebuilt — DIMHANS Dharwad added
feed.body: Full RCI Clinical Psych tracker re-checked against the institute portals. Added DIMHANS Dharwad (RCI, own psychiatric hospital for in-house clinical hours, run under a NIMHANS MOU). Two gates on it: Karnataka domicile is mandatory and the M.Phil track is only 4 seats. Cycle historically opens ~Sep–Oct.

feed.title: RML / ABVIMS deadline extended to 7 June
feed.body: ABVIMS / Dr RML Hospital pushed its MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application deadline from 30 May to 7 June 2026 on the GGSIPU portal. That makes it your earliest live window, so it goes first.

feed.title: Christ University is CLOSED (the 'June 14' was wrong)
feed.body: Earlier note said Christ Delhi NCR was open until 14 June. That is wrong: Christ's RCI MA Clinical Psych closed 2 February 2026 with the entrance in February. Don't chase it for this cycle. If you see a 'Delhi NCR June' date anywhere it's a different non-RCI stream, check the RCI tag first.

feed.title: NIMHANS MA Clinical Psych entrance held (31 May)
feed.body: NIMHANS ran its PG entrance window 29–31 May 2026, MA Clinical Psychology paper on 31 May. 100 MCQ / 90 min, +1 / −0.25 (exactly your mock scale). This year's cycle is now closed; result is the live thread.

feed.title: NFSU Gandhinagar + Delhi windows open (due 10 June)
feed.body: Both NFSU RCI MA Clinical Psych campuses are taking applications, due 10 June, selected on CUET-PG score. This corrects the earlier 'NFSU own entrance' line, there's no separate NFSU test.

feed.title: MAHE / Manipal MET held — this was your exam
feed.body: The MET you sat was the Manipal MA Clinical Psychology entrance. No fresh application here, the result + counselling is the live thread (see the MET result watch above).

feed.title: MET 2026 Phase 1 scorecard released
feed.body: MAHE released the MET 2026 Phase 1 result on 17 April. Scores are visible after logging in at manipal.edu. Merit and counselling for the Clinical Psych program follow from this.

feed.title: M.Phil Clinical Psychology replaced by the RCI MA
feed.body: From 2026, under NEP 2020 + RCI restructuring, the old M.Phil Clinical Psychology is being replaced by the MA Clinical Psychology (RCI). So the RCI-tagged MA at NIMHANS / CIP / IHBAS / NFSU IS the licensing program now, not a lesser step. A plain MA/MSc with no RCI tag does not license you. The only thing that matters is the RCI tag.

feed.title: 2027 cycle — the heavy hitters reopen Dec 2026–Feb 2027
feed.body: NIMHANS, IHBAS, CIP Ranchi and RINPAS typically open applications between December 2026 and February 2027, entrances around April–May. If this cycle doesn't land, that's your real runway for the top RCI seats. This board will flag each one the day it opens.
